title: 第415章 姬家来人第414章 纵横捭阖
slug: 凡人修仙我百世轮回成道祖
content_zh:
第415章：姬家来人
“这么说来，妖族最恨的百家祖师，一定是纵横祖师无疑了。”
“只可惜啊，
他老人家留下来的这些“传统手艺”，
怎么现在仙魔两道玩不转呢？
反而让一众邪魔，妖族，由此登堂入室，频频陷入被动！”
陈默轻叹一声，
他心中明白，
当年纵横子能用内乱葬送妖族纪元，
如今郑耀宗未必不会照葫芦画瓢。
两千六百多年后的末日大劫还没到，
但说不定，
人族内部早就被他策反了不知多少势力。
等到大劫真正降临，
不用邪魔动手，
光是内乱就能先把正道底蕴耗空，
到时候遍地人奸内应，
防线不攻自破！
想到这里，
陈默眼中寒光一闪，

心底已经有了决断。
星河盟这种趁火打劫、通敌内乱的势力，没有任何存在的必要。
“他们不是作死，是有恃无恐。”
陈默眸光深邃，
寻常势力，
绝不会在大劫将至的敏感时期大肆内斗，一旦消耗正道有生力量，待到邪魔入侵，最先覆灭的就是他们自己。
星河盟敢这么明目张胆的吞并扩张，
只有一个可能——背后有人撑腰，暗藏惊天阴谋！
“大劫在即，众生皆危，唯独他们借机称王，这份底气，绝非普通星空势力能拥有。”
陈默沉声说道，
“看来玄黄大世界的水，比我想象的还要深。”
猫胆听得一脸严肃，
小爪子攥得紧紧的：
“那还等啥！
主人咱们赶紧过去制止他们！
大敌当前还搞内斗，纯纯蛀虫！
不收拾他们，正道迟早被自己人玩死！”
“走。”
content_en:
Chapter 415: Someone from the Ji family comes
"So, there is no doubt that the founder of the hundred schools of thought that the demon clan hates the most is the founder of Zongheng."
"It's a pity,
These "traditional crafts" left by his old man,
Why can't we play with immortals and demons now?
Instead, a group of evil spirits and demon clans were allowed to enter the house and frequently fell into passivity! "
Chen Mo sighed softly,
He understood in his heart,
Back then, Zong Hengzi was able to ruin the era of demon clan with civil strife.
Nowadays, Zheng Yaozong may not be able to copy the gourd and draw the scoop.
The doomsday disaster more than 2,600 years later has not yet arrived.
But maybe,
He had already instigated countless forces within the human race to rebel.
When the catastrophe really comes,
No need for the devil to take action,
Civil strife alone can first deplete the foundation of the righteous path.
When the time comes, there will be traitors all over the place.
The defense line breaks down without attack!
Thinking of this,
Chen Mo's eyes flashed coldly,
I have already made a decision in my heart.
There is no need for a force like the Galaxy Alliance, which takes advantage of the situation and collaborates with the enemy and civil strife, to exist.
"They are not seeking death, they are confident."
Chen Mo's eyes were deep,
Ordinary forces,
They will never engage in internal fighting during the sensitive period when the catastrophe is approaching. Once the vitality of the righteous path is consumed, when the evil spirits invade, they themselves will be the first to be destroyed.
The Galaxy Alliance dares to annex and expand so blatantly,
There is only one possibility - there is someone behind it, hiding a shocking conspiracy!
"A great catastrophe is imminent, and all living beings are in danger. They are the only ones who take the opportunity to become kings. This kind of confidence is definitely not possessed by ordinary starry forces."
Chen Mo said in a deep voice,
"It seems that the water in the Xuanhuang World is deeper than I thought."
Mao Dan looked serious when he heard that.
The little paws clenched tightly:
"Then what are you waiting for!
Master, let’s hurry over and stop them!
The enemy is currently engaging in internal strife, they are just worms!
If you don't deal with them, Zhengdao will be killed by your own people sooner or later! "
"Let's go."
